blocks.title: Dative bond
blocks.text: Dative bond do atoms ke darmiyan tab banta hai jab baanta hua electron jora bandhan banane wale atoms mein se ek deta hai.

H2O aur proton H+ ke darmiyan bond banne par ghaur karein. Pani mein do covalent bonds hain aur oxygen atom par electrons ke do lone pairs; proton mein electrons ki kami hai. Is liye oxygen atom apna ek lone pair qabool karne wale (acceptor) H+ ko de sakta hai, jis se dative bond aur oxonium (hydronium) ion H3O+ banta hai. Carbon monoxide mein bhi oxygen aur carbon ke darmiyan dative bond hai. Oxygen apne do valence electrons carbon ke saath baant kar mamool ka double covalent bond banati hai, magar in bonds se carbon ki valency poori nahi hoti; use octet mukammal karne ke liye ek aur jora chahiye, aur oxygen apna ek lone pair de kar covalent bond banati hai jo dative bond hai.

Ozone oxygen molecule aur oxygen atom, ek free radical, ke taamul se banti hai. Molecule ka ek oxygen atom is free radical ke saath coordinate covalent bond banane ke liye electron jora deta hai, to darmiyani atom ke kul teen bonds hain, ek taraf double covalent bond aur doosri taraf coordinate covalent bond. Darmiyani atom par musbat charge hai, jabke lone pair qabool karne wale oxygen atom par manfi charge.

blocks.prompt: BF3 mein boron ke gird chhe valence electrons hain. Dikhayein ke NH3 aur BF3 ke darmiyan dative bond kaise banta hai, aur kaun sa atom donor hai.
blocks.explanation: NH3 mein nitrogen ke paas lone pair hai; BF3 mein boron ke paas sirf teen bond pairs, chhe electrons, aur ek khali orbital hai jo do aur qabool kar sakta hai. Nitrogen ka lone pair boron ke khali orbital mein diya jata hai, jo H3N se BF3 ka dative bond deta hai; nitrogen donor hai aur boron acceptor, aur ab dono ka octet hai.

items: Dative (coordinate covalent) bond: dono baante hue electrons ek atom se aate hain. H3O+ (O ka lone pair H+ ko), CO (O ka lone pair double bond ke saath C ko), O3 (O2 ki ek O oxygen free radical ko deti hai; darmiyani O +, acceptor O -).
